# Lunora

> Lunora is an Islamic app for Muslim women on iPhone and Android: prayer times, the whole Quran, duas and dhikr with widgets, and Period Mode, which follows the cycle alongside worship with the views of the four madhhabs (Hanafi, Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali). No ads. 9 languages. Lunora+ subscription with a 7-day free trial.

- Publisher: Studio Lunora. Website: https://mylunora.app/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6758765933
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.studiolunora.lunora
- Languages (app and site): English (en), Türkçe (tr), العربية (ar), Deutsch (de), Français (fr), Bahasa Indonesia (id), বাংলা (bn), Bahasa Melayu (ms), اردو (ur)
- Rating: 4.7 · 650+ reviews on the App Store and Google Play
- Religious content presents scholarly views with sources; the app and site do not issue rulings.
- Free web tool: an online tasbih (dhikr) counter, in every language below.
